judged_text: zoho-bigin passes `credentialId` to refreshOAuthTokens' `userId` parameter while every other call site passes `credential.userId`. If `credentialId` is the numeric credential id rather than the user id, the sync endpoint receives the wrong identifier (or undefined, silently disabling sync for zoho-bigin), so zoho-bigin credentials either sync under the wrong user or never sync at all — inconsistent with the sibling call sites in the same diff.
